It generates stratified sample points based on an existing land cover map (LC2), computes multiple vegetation and built-up indices, and evaluates classification accuracy using training and testing datasets.
proposed_known_omissions: The full feature-stack/classifier/evaluation workflow is too large for a single fixed chain without split-subworkflow policy. Display and dictionary reporting are also outside the target.
proposed_review_notes: The new chain recovers many spectral indices, stratified sampling, Random Forest training, classification, and accuracy metrics, but it is a 272-call composite with multiple model/evaluation phases. Defer until it is split into bounded feature-construction, sampling/training, and evaluation subworkflows.

salvage_reason: Monthly NDVI aggregation is partly represented, but the SR mathematical transform, renaming, and monthly image metadata/timestamp construction are missing.
task_description: The script computes monthly mean NDVI and derived Soil Reflectance (SR) from MODIS MOD13Q1 imagery over a region of interest for the year 2018. It processes the NDVI band by scaling it (dividing by 10000), then calculates SR using a mathematical transformation of NDVI, renames it, and aggregates images into monthly composites by taking the mean. The output is a monthly time-series ImageCollection with NDVI and SR bands, each image labeled with year, month, and timestamp for temporal analysis.
proposed_known_omissions: Print output and non-core display behavior are omitted; retained target is monthly NDVI/SR image collection construction.
proposed_review_notes: The new chain recovers MODIS date/bounds/select, clipping, NDVI scaling, SR arithmetic transform, monthly calendar filtering, mean aggregation, metadata setting, flattening, and ImageCollection.fromImages construction.
